spec.hypothesis: After successful local token correction, native role or body-part competition may remain. Trace the two new wrong continuations and a newly correct friend answer through every attention and MLP component.
spec.data: Exactly three recorded free responses from the frozen contrast candidate, including stop positions. Original and edited models receive the same histories for diagnostic comparison.
spec.attribution: Additive effective-decoder contrast, with actual repetition factors and final RMS. Record head and neuron contributions and verify their sum against the residual. Attribution is not a causal ablation.

interpretation_limit: Original decisions are counterfactual on edited histories, not original free responses. Component attribution is additive evidence, not proof that deleting that component improves generation.
